thread:
sam: Heads-up — we should design a new synthetic traffic generator to repro the KV + batching perf regression. Want focused apples-to-apples runs that exercise kernel selection, KV hot/cold transitions, and batching heuristics. Thoughts? :eyes:
maria: +1. Proposed primitives: epoch-based ramps, interleaved microbursts, deterministic KV-hotness flip, and a seeding model for reproducibility. Keep epochs short and composable.
sam: sketch of epochs: warmup(60s, low qps), ramp(30s linear to target), steady(120s), microburst-pass (n spikes), cooldown. Each epoch emits requests with metadata so we can force kernel selection.
priya: we should add a request header for kernel control so runtime can pick path for apples-to-apples: `X-Test-Kernel: fused_v2` or `X-Test-Kernel: fallback`. Also add `X-KV-TTL` to simulate cache churn per-request.
maria: batch heuristics idea: a target window (ms) + adaptive backoff when latency drift observed. Keep a safety max-batch for long sequences. Pseudo-cmd:
```
./synthgen --seed 42 --epochs "warmup:60,range:10-100,ramp:30,steady:120" \n          --microburst "count:5,peak:1000,shape:log" \n          --kernel-tag fused_v2 --kv-ttl 30 --batch-window-ms 6 --max-batch 128
```
sam: for the replay harness, capture production traces into 'event buckets' (ts + key_id + input_len). Replay should preserve inter-arrival jitter but allow an amplification factor to hit target QPS. Use deterministic seeding for ordering.
dev-bot: perfbot: Regression detected in canary run 2026-03-05 — +12% p99 when kernel switched to fused_v2 on nv4x. Log: /perf/2026/341234 (TL;DR: KV miss storms + increased batch fragmentation).
tal: add profiler hooks that emit: kv_hit_rate, batch_size_histogram, kernel_switch_count, kv_latency_p95/p99. PromExport preferred so ops dashboards pick it up. Also record per-epoch summaries to correlate with epoch-type.
priya: measurement plan (short): run kernel variants back-to-back on same hw, same weights; use `--seed` to align ordering; do `--replay-runs 5`, collect p50/p95/p99 and batch distributions; take median run. Tag results with run-id + kernel-tag for traceability.
maria: note about KV warmup: TTL and hot-key churn matter a lot. Don't do a single static hotset. Use Zipf popularity but periodically flip top-k to cold (decay mode) so we exercise eviction/warmup behavior.
sam: also add a 'burst interleaver' primitive — interleave short high-qps bursts across many keys to trigger KV miss amplification without saturating network. That helped us reproduce the last outage.
priya: example runtime command to run apples-to-apples:
```
./synthgen --replay trace.pb --seed 9001 --amplify 3 --kernel-tag fused_v2 --replay-runs 5 --out /tmp/runs/341234
```
maria: i'll draft the trace schema (event: {ts, key_id, op, size, meta}) and a small JSON manifest for epochs + seeds. Will PR later today.
sam: next steps: maria+priya to own synthgen CLI + trace schema, tal to add profiler hooks + dashboards, i'll wire replay recorder into the harness and run a baseline sweep in staging next week. :white_check_mark:
priya: leaving a short checklist in tracker for the experiment matrix (kernels x kv-ttl x burst-shape x seed).
maria: ack, will post PR and example traces when ready.
sam: thanks everyone — assigning followups in tracker.
